stem.en: A cart starts from rest and moves with a constant acceleration of 2 m/s². Plot its velocity-time graph from t = 0 s to t = 5 s.

explanation.en: The velocity grows by 2 m/s every second: 2 m/s at 1 s, 4 m/s at 2 s, 6 m/s at 3 s. The points lie on a straight line through the origin.

hints.en: Starting from rest, the velocity after t seconds is 2 x t m/s.
